thread:
rachel: Filing this here because support escalated a customer who saw huge provisional charges after a streaming session with a mid-request truncation. Looks related to tool-call retry + streaming resume.
marco: Can you paste a short trace? curious if truncation caused a lost final_ack or if the router replayed from an earlier prefix.
rachel: Minimal log:
```
[INFO] session=orgX-77 prefix_hash=0xabc start_ts=2025-03-02T09:12:01Z attempt=foo1 event=stream_start
[INFO] attempt=foo1 event=tool_invoke tokens=230
[INFO] attempt=foo1 event=stream_chunk seq=45
[ERROR] server-side truncation triggered (outgoing connection closed)
[INFO] client reconnect after 2s new_attempt=foo2 event=stream_resume resume_seq=45
[INFO] attempt=foo2 event=tool_invoke tokens=230 provisional=true
[INFO] ledger provisional_charge id=foo2 tokens=230
[WARN] original attempt foo1 had no final_ack and ledger row for it is missing
```
nina: Interesting: if truncation killed the writer before the final ack, the ledger never saw confirmation for foo1. Router replay created foo2 and we provisional-charged foo2. But why is there no row for foo1? maybe we never emitted provisional for the first attempt because the writer crashed before the provisional emit path finished.
leo: That would mean the ledger sees only the replay provisional and later confirms, but customer sees a spike of provisional because billing export collects short-term provisional rows from many replays.
billing-bot: billing-bot: Request: add ledger field "truncation_cause" and "provisional_hold" (true/false) to indicate rows held pending reconciliation. Also include original_attempt_id when available.
marco: Telemetry idea: emit fields `resume_seq`, `truncation_marker`, `original_prefix_len`, `attempt_emitted_provisional` (bool) and `final_ack_seen`. We can then measure how often first attempt failed before provisional emit.
rachel: UX: console needs two things: 1) a small explainer that provisional may include in-flight replays and truncation artifacts; 2) an export filter to drop provisional rows or only show confirmed costs. Support wants a quick "explain" link that shows traces tied to provisional ledger rows.
leo: Short-term mitigation: router should emit a provisional row as early as possible on tool_invoke so both attempts produce provisional entries; then reconcile by attempt mapping to avoid orphaned/missing rows. Alternatively, mark replay provisional rows with `provisional_hold=true` so they are visible but not actionable until reconciliation.
marco: Risk: if we hold too long we underbill when the original genuinely failed and client retried legitimately. So default hold window should be small (e.g., 60s) and we provide reconciliation to finalize.
nina: Long-term: persist attempt->session mapping in a tiny durable store so replays can be correlated even if the original crashed. Also make SDKs set session_id and resume_seq to help deterministic dedupe.
billing-bot: filed BILL-1102 to add ledger tags and CSV export fields. infra: INFRA-2456 to prototype provisional_hold semantics in ledger.
leo: Action items: rachel will attach customer traces to the ticket; marco + nina will prototype router change to emit provisional earlier and tag replays; billing-bot will add ledger schema changes; claire in console will mock the "provisional-only view" and explain copy.
rachel: Thanks. I'll also add recommended SDK change note to require session_id in latest minor release.
marco: pairing with @nina for a quick PoC tomorrow.
leo: :rocket:
